verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a simplified Sessions flow that needs only one server-side /sessions call, an advanced three-call flow, client SDKs for web, iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter, and a test environment, so a guided payment-flow integration from the docs exists. Nothing in the pack shows copy-paste code samples in multiple server languages or backs an under-a-day integration time. Community reports call Adyen harder to integrate than Stripe and "bare metal", though one consultant found it reasonable. missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code examples per language/server SDK, evidence of time-to-first-payment under a day, independent hands-on corroboration of quick integration.
